info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Amazon Security Lake API (2018-05-10). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Only the data lake exception subscription is served, as configuration metadata that needs no data lake: no AWS or custom log source is ingested, so no exception occurs and no notification is ever sent to the endpoint. GetDataLakeExceptionSubscription returns no members before a subscription exists, UpdateDataLakeExceptionSubscription stores a subscription even when none exists, and a second CreateDataLakeExceptionSubscription is refused with ConflictException. Data lakes, log sources, subscribers and subscriber notifications, organization configuration, delegated administrators, data lake exceptions and tagging return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501.
